analyst_view.overall: Nice (7th, 17 pts) host Troyes (14th, 11 pts) on Saturday evening. Olivier Pantaloni's Nice lost 3-2 at home to PSG last time, ending a run of three wins, and were unbeaten at home before that; Troyes beat bottom side Le Havre 3-1. Nice are missing several defenders and midfielders (Antoine Mendy, Mohamed Abdelmonem, Lumpungu and Laurent Abergel are listed out, and Bombito was also unlikely last week), and Troyes are without forward Yacouba Kone and defender Gozzi. The numbers list no missing players for either side, but Nice's absentees also missed the PSG game, so their recent form already shows the effect. No referee is named, nothing beyond a mid-table home game is at stake, and news was thin (no dedicated preview yet), so the view stays with the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, 1.7 for Nice, who have scored 14 in their last six with Elye Wahi as their main scorer. Nice's patched defence has been patched for weeks and is in their recent form, and Troyes' loss of Kone is minor, so I stay at 2.7.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.5 corners, slightly more for Troyes, and the momentum already trims both sides a little. Nothing in the team news changes how either side attacks, so I stay at about 8.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards, already pushed up because Nice have picked up 17 cards in their last six and Troyes' opponents get booked often. Troyes' Antoine Mille is a frequent booking, but that is in their season numbers, and with no referee named I stay at 4.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.9 shots, already trimmed because Troyes have allowed few shots lately and Nice have shot less than usual. I found nothing on tactics or rotation that the numbers can't see, so I stay at about 23.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target, 4.6 for Nice. Nice's attack is intact and Troyes' defence has been tight lately, both already in the numbers, so I stay at about 8.
